field.label: Force zero results for disabled categories
field.comment: If set to yes, any virtual category that references a disabled category in their rule or as their root category will return an empty result. Be careful modifying this option will remove all your category query cache.

field.label: Treat the store root category as a purely physical category in rules
field.comment: When a category condition of a rule (virtual categories, optimizers, widgets) or a GraphQL category filter uses the store root category, only the products assigned to the physical categories of the store tree are used, without expanding every virtual category of the store. Set to No to restore the legacy behaviour, which can produce very large queries.

field.label: Boundary categories for virtual rules
field.comment: Comma-separated ids of large/top categories (eg. a category holding a significant portion of the catalog) whose virtual subcategories must not be expanded when any virtual category relies on them. When a virtual category uses one of them as its virtual root, or in a category condition in its rules, the boundary category is treated as a physical category without any virtual subcategory. This keeps the queries of virtual categories referencing the boundary category small. The page and the layered navigation of the boundary category itself are unchanged. These boundary categories should be anchor categories.
